apk.notes: 0.14.0: the phone app now updates itself. Updates download in the background and are used the next time the app opens; a new version of the app itself is offered with Install when one is needed.

web.notes: 0.14.0: the phone app now updates itself. Updates download in the background and are used the next time the app opens; a new version of the app itself is offered with Install when one is needed.

desktop.notes: 2.15.0: the program now updates itself. New versions download in the background; Restart now switches, or they're used the next time it opens. Settings → Updates shows the version and checks on demand.
